task.description: Re-check rework 1 of ISS-0524's design: header-search mechanism replacing the flat 40-line tail.

result.note: Independently re-ran mix test --only wasm_hang --dry-run live 4 times (1 cold, 3 warm): header-to-terminator span consistently exactly 232 lines every run, matching the design's SS3.2 claim precisely; line offsets shift a few lines run-to-run with compile cache warmth but span itself is stable. find_discovery_window/2's header-anchored window mechanism directly fixes the flat-tail defect. Header-absent vs header-present-but-empty distinction correctly implemented (SS3.2's :header_not_found more-severe framing + 40-line generic fallback with a distinguishing marker, vs a targeted header-anchored window). 300-line bound gives 68 lines of margin over the measured 232-line span, reasonable not razor-thin. No silent completeness claim on bound exhaustion: {:header_found, window, terminator_reached?} shape with terminator_reached? = false explicitly required to produce a bound-reached message, confirmed present in SS3.2/SS3.3/SS4. Header string-matching verified against real extract_test_list_block/1 (lib/mix/tasks/letflow.check.test.ex:476-492): exact-line-equality header match matches the design's description exactly; one cosmetic prose imprecision noted (design says terminator match is exact-equality for one form, real code uses starts_with?/2 for both) but confirmed behaviorally identical on all real and fixture output, not a FAIL condition. Scope/regression checks: docs/issues/ISS-0524.yaml unchanged since prior commit (git diff empty); retry decision/logic (SS1/SS3.1), scope exclusions (SS0), and data shape (SS2) all untouched in substance, only SS3.2/SS3.3/SS5/SS6 changed. New fixtures (install_wasm_hang_retry_noisy_window_fake_mix/1, install_wasm_hang_no_header_fake_mix/1) well-specified to exercise the three new distinctions with specific message-content assertions, not just no-raise checks. No disguised executable code (grep clean). Design is unambiguous and complete enough to hand to ELIXIR-DEV as-is.
